messages:
Kara: quick question on pin schema: do we need a `deprecation_window` field to indicate soft-deprecation semantics? idea is to let control-plane mark upcoming deprecations and signal clients.
Ben: yes, useful. define as duration in seconds or an RFC3339 end time? prefer `deprecated_at` timestamp + `deprecation_notice` string.
Joey: runtime action: when deprecation is within X (configurable), trigger telemetry events and optional auto-reroute. but keep policy opt-in.
Kara: proposed fields added to pin draft: `deprecated_at`, `deprecation_reason`, `deprecation_action`= `notify|auto_reroute|block`.
Ben: nit: `deprecation_action` should be per-tenant overrideable. enterprise customers may set `block` stricter.
Joey: also add `audit_refs` list to point to provenance entries explaining deprecation. helps support.
infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-8242 for `deprecation_action` enforcement (ETA 4d).
Kara: action items: Ben will make tenant override policy; Joey will add telemetry hooks; I will fold into pin v2 docs. closing.
